presentation_revision_history.prompt: One respectful painterly realistic Egyptian mythology illustration, portrait2:3, NO text. Sokar as documented MUMMIFIED HAWK form. A single intact ceremonial hawk representation with natural unmistakable hawk head, hooked beak and bird eye, the avian body carefully wrapped in tidy linen, two folded bird wings suggested under the wrappings; not a human mummy, not hawk-headed man. Resting upright on plain limestone pedestal in quiet alcove, natural evening sunlight through doorway. Solemn dignity through watchful gaze and silhouette. Non-gory devotional iconographic representation, no injury, no exposed remains, no snake/wing composites or crowns invented. No magical aura, luminous mist, neon outline or floating symbols. Editorial scene and bandage arrangement.
